breadth_audit._purpose: Actor-attribution audit. publishers_excluded is an exact set-difference against breadth_config.publisher_slugs; contrast count is best-effort.
breadth_audit.contrast_comentions_excluded: ~18 — Grok 4.6 / DeepSeek V4 Pro / Qwen3.8-2.4T benchmark roundups kept to their own subject topics (GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5, named only for price and Intelligence-Index contrast, were NOT cross-credited); Handelsblatt, Reuters, TechCrunch, FT, WSJ, Bloomberg, VentureBeat, simonwillison, semianalysis, latentspace and stratechery excluded as messengers.

config_snapshot._purpose: exact tuning constants in effect this run, for reproducibility

convergence_multiplier._comment: When a topic appears in N or more DIFFERENT source types, score is multiplied. Counters monoculture (single-source loud day) and rewards cross-source agreement.

thresholds._comment: Lowered 2026-06-03 from 15/20 alongside BREADTH_PLAN actor-attribution. Removing publishers + contrast co-mentions shrinks every topic's org set, so the old 15/20 floor (set against the inflated distribution) would almost never fire. After the first corrected radar run, read breadth_audit.median_breadth_30d and re-tune: high_breadth_7d ~= top-third of the NEW distribution, very_high ~= top-quartile.

emerging.description: Early signal. 1-2 weak sources or one strong novel source. Worth watching.

consolidating.description: Multiple independent sources are converging on the same take. Pattern is forming.

mainstream.description: Consensus. Most credible sources reference this; further coverage is incremental.

fading._trigger: score declined >25% over rolling window AND was previously >=50
fading.description: Was hot, now declining. Useful to know — don't bet here, expect coverage to dry up.
